quantitative_reading.admission_recommendation: A narrow plot-level response-amplitude statement can use this explicitly defined reviewer graph estimate after root visual adjudication. If root finds the graph extraction insufficient, keep this review as insufficient_evidence; do not replace it by p-value-as-effect-size.

metric_record_candidate.definition: Reviewer graph estimate: max of the plotted across-animal mean ΔF/F trace in paired-odor motion epoch 2 minus max of the plotted mean trace in pre-odor motion epoch 1, Fig3A. 0.16ΔF/F equals16 percentage points of ΔF/F; it is not a16% relative increase, mean of individual maxima, or original author-tabulated number.

uncertainty.description: Conservative graph-reading interval only (12–19 percentage points), covering independent PDF-vector and raster extraction with±1pixel per peak and±1pixel scale calibration plus rounded stroke/geometry allowance. This is not SEM, SD, CI, biological variability, or a statistical interval. Published gray band is mean±1SEM; no SEM magnitude is reconstructed.

vector_method.curve_sampling: All line vertices and51uniform t samples for each cubicBezier in the filled black trace contour. Minimum y in each motion-epoch window is the upper edge of the plotted mean trace, a graph estimate with finite stroke thickness.

independent_raster_check.threshold: R<100 AND G<100 AND B<100, within the fixed plot windows, excluding asterisk labels and gray SEM band

quantitative_reading.rounding: Proposed display≈0.16ΔF/F; graph-reading range0.12–0.19. Avoid more significant digits.
quantitative_reading.statistical_result_separation: Published rank-sum p<.05 concerns author peak-response comparisons, not a test newly run on the extracted group-mean-trace difference. No new significance test was performed.

proposed_assessment_core.effect: 在明确果蝇Hx钙成像条件下，配对气味与视觉运动时，图示群体均值轨迹的峰值约增加0.16ΔF/F（图形读数范围0.12–0.19）；这是约16个百分点，非16%相对增益。作者另报告峰响应比较rank-sum p<0.05。
proposed_assessment_core.biological_implications: 对Hx视觉反应的评价需要包括嗅觉上下文；只支持所测果蝇细胞/刺激下的响应调制，不证明丽蝇Hx模型或跨物种同源性。
proposed_assessment_core.engineering_implications: 把同一视觉输入的响应变化全部解释为速度变化可能混入感觉上下文调制；工程传感器是否需要类似上下文增益控制仍须另行验证。
proposed_assessment_core.remaining_limitations: 没有验证最优匹配滤波、完整运动恢复或平台内幅值编码；没有隔离Hx的因果行为干预。主文不提供作者原始数值表或确切检验统计量，图形估计不是原始数据；未核验补充实验方法，因而不作对比度/纹理/光照/浓度泛化。
